description: Arcade.dev LLM tools for getting financial data via Google Finance

tools.name: GetStockHistory
tools.description:
Fetch historical stock price data over a specified time window

Returns a stock's price and volume data over a specified time window

parameters.name: ticker_symbol
parameters.description: The stock ticker to get summary for. For example, 'GOOG' is the ticker symbol for Google

parameters.name: exchange_identifier
parameters.description: The exchange identifier. This part indicates the market where the stock is traded. For example, 'NASDAQ', 'NYSE', 'TSE', 'LSE', etc.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Time window for the graph data. Defaults to 1 month

output.description: A stock's price and volume data at a specific time interval over a specified time window

tools.name: GetStockSummary
tools.description:
Retrieve the summary information for a given stock ticker using the Google Finance API.

Gets the stock's current price as well as price movement from the most recent trading day.

parameters.name: exchange_identifier

documentationChunks.content:
The Arcade Google Finance MCP Server uses the [SerpAPI](https://serpapi.com/) to get stock data from Google Finance.
- **Secret:**
  - `SERP_API_KEY`: Your SerpAPI API key.
    <Callout type="info">
      Setting the `SERP_API_KEY` secret is only required if you are
      [self-hosting](/guides/deployment-hosting/configure-engine) Arcade. If you're
      using Arcade Cloud, the secret is already set for you. To manage your
      secrets, go to the [Secrets
      page](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets) in the Arcade
      Dashboard.
    </Callout>
---

## GoogleFinanceWindow

Defines the time window for fetching stock data from Google Finance.

- **`ONE_DAY`**: Represents a 1-day time window.
- **`FIVE_DAYS`**: Represents a 5-day time window.
- **`ONE_MONTH`**: Represents a 1-month time window.
- **`SIX_MONTHS`**: Represents a 6-month time window.
- **`YEAR_TO_DATE`**: Represents the time from the start of the year to the current date.
- **`ONE_YEAR`**: Represents a 1-year time window.
- **`FIVE_YEARS`**: Represents a 5-year time window.
- **`MAX`**: Represents the maximum available time window.

summary:
## Google Finance Toolkit

The Google Finance toolkit lets LLMs retrieve financial market data via [SerpApi's](https://serpapi.com) Google Finance integration. It provides tools for querying stock summaries and historical price data.

## Capabilities

- **Stock snapshots**: Fetch current price and intraday price movement for a given ticker symbol.
- **Historical price & volume data**: Query a stock's price and volume history over a specified time window.

## Secrets

`SERP_API_KEY` — A SerpApi API key used to authenticate all requests to the Google Finance endpoint. Obtain it by creating an account at [serpapi.com](https://serpapi.com), then navigating to your [dashboard](https://serpapi.com/dashboard) where your private API key is displayed. Free-tier accounts include a limited monthly search quota; paid plans are required for higher volume. No special scopes or permissions beyond account access are needed — the key grants access to all SerpApi endpoints your plan supports.

For guidance on storing secrets in Arcade, see the [Arcade secrets documentation](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets). You can also manage secrets directly at [https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
